name: D3 clustered-generator freeze gates v1
recorded_by: decided by the project owner; recorded before the clustered calibration results were inspected
disclosure: When these gates were recorded, generator_calibration_v1 had already computed the clustered cells (they were in its run log), but neither the project owner nor the assistant had viewed them. Uniform cells (the reference) and some cluster_bridge cells had been seen.

G1_connectivity.note: Wilson 95% CI is reported but is not a pass/fail condition

G2_clustering_identity.applies_to: clustered (D3) versus uniform at the same (n, density); clustering share is reported for all geometries but other geometries are not required to look clustered
G2_clustering_identity.rule: D3 median clustering share >= 1.5 x uniform median, AND D3 Q1 > uniform Q3

G3_degree_regime.rule: R(n) = mean degree D3 / mean degree uniform (cell medians of per-graph mean degree); R(n) <= 4 in every cell, AND within each density max_n R(n) / min_n R(n) <= 2 over all tested n

sparse_admission.applies_to: density-5 cells of the optional sparse study
sparse_admission.rule: connected >= 18 of 24 validation graphs (same as G1)

on_failure: A failing gate is never loosened. If G3 (or G1/G2) fails for D3, the generator is redesigned (e.g. hotspot count growing with n while keeping the 50% background, or sigma scaled ~ sqrt(n)) and re-calibrated on new independent validation seeds against these same gates.
expectation_recorded_in_advance: With 4 hotspots, fixed sigma = 0.8 and n/8 points per hotspot, same-hotspot degree grows ~ Theta(n) while uniform degree stays O(1), so R(n) is expected to grow with n and G3 is expected to fail.
